## Intent — what this is for

A git-backed markdown notebook (versioned, portable). Scoped as a NOTEBOOK EDITOR app, not a second knowledge store — coordinates with Knowledge.

## Done when

The notes app ships as its own validated PersonalClawApps PR built to the app-creation contract (app.json, SDK-only imports, minimum permissions, test_provider.py/test_server.py, README, LICENSE), validated by adding it as a local Store source and driving it in the real UI; listed in the Store and recorded in ECOSYSTEM-TOOLING's exemplar list; notes are versioned in git and survive app reinstall; no parallel knowledge store is created.
